CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red), an explicit organization/pattern (coordinate sets) and a distinct origin/status field are all present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified contents' presentation or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colors (red/blue) bound to coordinate sets and named referents.

D.rationale: Separate origin/status fields are provided alongside content lists, distinguishing content identity from provenance/status.

O.rationale: Entries explicitly present how contents are organized/presented as coordinate patterns and label states (current vs candidate).
